Shipping & Returns

Processing time

Every Florence Mae Gifts item is handmade to order, so there is a make time before your order ships. It depends on the item, and each listing shows its own:

  • 5–7 business days: Crochet Shadow Monster Baby Hat, Luffy Inspired Baby Straw Hat, Gohan Inspired Crochet Hat, Rumi Inspired Hat / Beanie, Goku Inspired Baby Hat, Chiaotzu Inspired Baby Photo Set Costume, Goku Gohan Inspired Four Star Hat, Chiaotzu Inspired Hat, Shenron Shenlong Gohan Inspired Hat
  • 7–9 business days: Trunks Inspired Beanie & Diaper Cover Photo Set Costume, Majin Buu Inspired Diaper Cover Baby Set Costume, Monster Diaper Cover Baby Set Costume, Turtles Diaper Cover Baby Set Costume, Santa Diaper Cover Set, Chi Chi Dragon Ball Baby Diaper Set, Where's Waldo Inspired Diaper Cover Baby Set, Shenron Shenlong Gohan Inspired Hat Photo Set
  • 1–2 weeks: Luffy Inspired Baby Photo Set, Alakazam Inspired Baby Photo Set, Togepi Inspired Baby Photo Set, Dumbo Inspired Diaper Cover Baby Set, Goku Inspired Costume with Baby Onesie and Hat

Shipping

  • Shipping is free on every physical item.
  • Orders ship by USPS Ground Advantage, which usually takes 2–5 business days in transit.
  • We ship to all 50 U.S. states. International shipping is not available.
  • Crochet pattern PDFs are digital: a download link is emailed right after checkout and nothing is mailed.

Returns & refunds

  • Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery.
  • Condition: items must be returned new and unused to be eligible for a refund.
  • Returns are by mail. Send the item back to the address it was shipped from:
Florence Mae Gifts, LLC
PO Box 317
Parsonsburg, MD 21849
  • Return shipping: the buyer pays return shipping. We do not provide a return label.
  • Restocking fee: none.
  • Refund timing: once the item arrives it is inspected, and your refund is issued to the original payment method within 7 business days of the returned item arriving.
  • Exchanges: we do not offer exchanges. To get a different size or item, return the original for a refund and place a new order.
  • Digital pattern PDFs are delivered instantly and cannot be returned. If there is a problem with your file, contact us and we will make it right.

Questions

Need help with an order, a size, or a return? Send us a message and we will get back to you.
